_about: Plan 2-3 (MyStockButler titles), 2026-10-29. The next results date each company announced ITSELF, opened that day on its own investor-relations page or press release (source_url, quote). An English earnings page gets '<name> earnings date: <date>' in its title only while this date is the page's own next_earnings and not past (scripts/lib/stocks.mjs earningsDateTitle). A company with no announcement is not listed: a projected date is never printed. Remove a row (or the file) to turn it off.
